thread:
alex: starting a short prelaunch checklist for tomorrow's rollout. change window opens 2026-05-01 03:00 UTC. need final signoffs, rollback criteria, and freeze-lift timing. tagging @maria @sam

maria: release notes updated here: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-05-feature-x — includes DB migration steps and observability runbook. please scan quick.

sam: @alex quick q — are we pinning the serving runtime to v2.4.1 for this rollout? we saw regressions on v2.5-rc.

alex: yes pin to v2.4.1 in the deploy config. i'll publish the exact helm snippet below.

alex: helm patch:
```
image:
  tag: v2.4.1
```

jess: oncall note: matt_oncall covers the 03:00-04:00 window. matt_oncall: i'll be available and watching alerts. set pager for >=P1.

deploy-bot: Canary started for svc-frontend (canary size 10). canary metrics streaming -> latency stable, errors 0.2% (threshold 1.0%).

sam: proposed rollback criteria: if p99 latency increases >50ms OR error rate >0.8% sustained for 5m -> automatic rollback to v2.4.0. also manual rollback if user-facing errors spike. thoughts?

maria: agree. also add content/regression monitor: if eval-run (smoke prompt set) fails sanity checks -> halt rollout and alert #product.

alex: who will cut the prod tag and update the release notes canonical link?

priya: i'll cut the tag at T+15m after successful canary and update release notes + trigger changelog publish job. i'll also attach the migration checklist in the ticket.

deploy-bot: Production rollout scheduled at 03:15 UTC. automatic fallback policy enabled: fallback to regional node-pool beta if GPU capacity constrained.

matt_oncall: i'll shadow the rollout, run a 5-minute smoke at T+5, and be ready to escalate. ping me in #eng-oncall or @matt_oncall if anything odd.

alex: final decision: freeze lift target = 03:45 UTC provided post-rollout smoke passes and no P1s. if any blocker -> keep freeze and require manual signoff from eng-release leads.

sam: +1 :thumbsup:

jess: merging final infra PR now (pin + scripts).

deploy-bot: PR merged by jess. build #2489 queued.

deploy-bot: build #2489 succeeded. canary ready.

alex: thanks all. i'll post the postmortem template link after rollout and mark owners for follow-up action items. good luck and reach out if anything comes up.
